data.content_ref: inline:The target's claim is '$864', which is arithmetically wrong for the stated problem. The correct total pay is (40×$18)+(7×$27)=$720+$189=$909. The target's own counterconditions concede the standard $855 calculation, yet $855 is also wrong because overtime at 1.5× the base replaces the base rate for overtime hours, giving 7×$27=$189, not $855 (which incorrectly uses 7×$27 as a premium add-on). The $864 claim is never supported by any correct reading of the prompt.
